Name: Shelomith, Son of Izhar
Summary: Chief of the sons of Izhar in David's divisions.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 23:18; 1 Chronicles 24:22: Chief of the sons of Izhar in David's divisions.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shelomith in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
